references.text: Moses repeats the exhortation not to fear the enemies, referencing how God dealt with Pharaoh and Egypt.
The priest exhorts Israel not to fear when they go out to war, for the Lord their God is with them.
Moses encourages the people to be strong and courageous, and not to fear the enemies.
God commands Joshua not to fear or be discouraged, the same exhortation Moses gave the people.
Joshua and Caleb exhort the people not to fear the people in the land, for the Lord is with them.
God's exhortation to Israel not to fear, for He is with them and will strengthen them.
Moses exhorts the people not to fear at the Red Sea, but to stand firm and see the Lord's salvation.
